d: This episode of Tarikh tells the remarkable story of the Bene Israel — one of India’s oldest Jewish communities. From their escape from persecution in the ancient world and a shipwreck on the Konkan coast to their centuries-long journey in India, the episode traces how they preserved their Jewish identity while becoming deeply connected to Maharashtra. It explores their military traditions, their links with Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj and the Maratha forces, their service under different Indian rulers and later in the British Indian Army, and their migration to Israel after 1948.
